input.quote: Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data ownership provision. The only proprietary-rights language is § 14(b), which is limited to each Party's names, trademarks and logos; § 6(a) merely makes AP liable for its Content, and § 9(b)(i)/(viii) confirm Kubient owns the Service, Auction Platform and "products delivered hereunder" without any assignment or licence-back of deliverables to AP. Nothing allocates ownership of AP's Content, Properties, Requests or the visitor data Kubient collects and stores under § 9(b)(iii). There is no assignment of AP IP to Kubient (so not walk-away territory), but neither the preferred nor the fallback position is met because AP has no ownership statement for its data and no perpetual licence to any deliverables. We therefore added a short ownership clause: AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and Customer Data; Kubient keeps its platform and background IP; any deliverables are assigned with a licence-back to embedded Kubient IP; and joint ownership is excluded.

proposal.summary: Add an ownership provision confirming AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and data, with assignment/licence-back of any deliverables and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no ownership of Content, data or deliverables, so we have added a provision confirming we retain all rights in our Content, Properties and Customer Data (including visitor and Request data) while Kubient keeps its Auction Platform and background IP. Our playbook requires that we own what we pay for and that nothing we contribute is assigned to or jointly owned with the vendor; we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any deliverables in place of assignment if Kubient prefers.

ops.text: (b) Ownership. As between the Parties, Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests and all data and information provided by Customer or collected, generated or stored by or on behalf of Kubient in connection with the Services or the Properties, including visitor and audience data (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient owns and retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and its other pre-existing technology, tools and know-how. To the extent Kubient creates any deliverable or work product specifically for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit, Kubient hereby assigns such deliverable or work product to Customer (excluding Kubient's pre-existing intellectual property) and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any Kubient intellectual property embedded therein for Customer's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Kubient any ownership of Customer Data or any other Customer intellectual property, and no Customer Data, deliverable or work product shall be jointly owned by the Parties.
